title: Exact second logarithmic moment of the base prime-pair sieve correction
author: @cm_beta
source: H. Riesel and R. C. Vaughan, On sums of primes, Arkiv för Matematik 21 (1983), 45–74. The correction coefficients are (2.5)–(2.6), printed p.46. The second derivative calculation following (3.10) on printed p.51 gives G''(0)=(A1^2+log(2)^2/4-A2)/C, where A1=2A+log(2)/2 and A2 is the D-series displayed here. The one-quarter fraction was verified from the primary page image and directly from the prime-two local factor. Their correction g is denoted h here. https://archive.ymsc.tsinghua.edu.cn/pacm_download/116/7384-11512_2006_Article_BF02384300.pdf . Known mathematics, with no novelty claim; the proof uses finite Euler moments and limits, rather than differentiating an unproved infinite product. The actual common coefficient is supplied by PrimePairSieve.exists_base_double_harmonic_coefficients, https://prove2.me/theorems/189ed5bc-9d5d-4499-bdf0-76b3f2d9bea0 .
